title: traffic/product/v1
description: The traffic information product of one subscriber (Reg. (EU) 2021/664 Art. 11; spec 01 §3 S4, 02 F5), at 1 Hz on WS /v1/traffic, once on GET /v1/traffic/snapshot, and sampled every 10 s on traffic.product.v1.<client_id> for the record (03 §3). It carries every track within the radius of the subscription (traffic_radius_m around an intent's envelope, or the console's bbox): this USSP's own flights, the peers' flights, manned traffic and e-conspicuity, each with its trust class (R-05: a broadcast track is always labelled broadcast), source, age and time of report; a track whose source went silent stays with its age as stale, one whose source was switched off as source_disabled, never removed silently (B-11, SC-16). alerts are the subscriber's active proximity alerts, ranked as the monitor ranks them; degraded names each input that is missing or stale and since when (an empty product never looks like an empty sky, SC-22). No member carries resolution advice (X-15).

bbox.description: GeoJSON bounding box [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 degrees (RFC 7946 §5).

state.description: live; stale (no sample for traffic_stale_after_s, age_s says how long); source_disabled (its source was switched off).

age_s.description: Seconds from the track's captured_at to the product's at.

identification.description: The identification status only (04 §3.2; no serial, no operator number); null for a track with none (manned).

time_of_report.description: The track's own time of report (Art. 11(3)(a)): its captured_at.

own.description: True for one of the subscriber's own flights.

peer_unavailable.description: True when the peer USSP that serves this track cannot be reached (WP-14); the track is its last report with its age.

input.description: The input, as a snake_case slug: manned (the ANSP feed), dss, cis, peers, monitor, alerts, source_control, policy.

since.description: Since when it is degraded; null when it has never been seen up.

for.description: What the product is for: an operator's intent (its envelope plus traffic_radius_m) or a staff bbox.

alerts.description: The subscriber's active proximity alerts (alert/v1 bodies).

dropped_frames.description: Frames and track updates held back for this connection since it opened: the throttle above traffic_throttle_track_count tracks (each track every other second), and frames dropped because the connection could not take them (05 §5).

throttled.description: True when this product carries only the tracks due this second (the throttle).
